question: Eight times P's present age is 12 years more than Q's present age. Eight years from now, three times Q's age will be 28 years less than eight times P's age. Find Q's present age (in years).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Expand the future condition: 3 × (Q + 8) = 8 × (P + 8) − 28

⇒ 3Q + 24 = 8P + 64 − 28

⇒ 3Q + 24 = 8P + 36

Directly substitute 8P = Q + 12 (from the present condition):

⇒ 3Q + 24 = (Q + 12) + 36 ⇒ 2Q = 24 ⇒ Q = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12 years.**
